question: What honor results from bathing there on the ninth lunar day?
premises: Bathing occurs there on the ninth day.
Honor is granted as a result.
The honor takes place in Brahmā’s world.
inference: Therefore one who bathes there on the ninth day is honored in Brahmā’s world.
plain_english: By bathing there on the ninth day, one is honored in the world of Brahmā.
